Nike B2B Sales Dashboard

Executive view for VP Penny · Period: January–September 2026
Scope & methodology: This dashboard is limited to NIKE and combines two non-overlapping sources: January–May Sales Data and the June–September Sell-out file. Total payment includes tax; SRP is Total Amount (SRP). PIC is standardized and available for filtering and ownership analysis. As transaction classifications differ across the two source files, this is an invoice-recorded sales view and should not be interpreted as store sell-through or inventory.
